what.text: This page follows refugees from Albania living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1171 Albanian refugees in Germany, 5.5% of all refugees from Albania.
France hosts the most Albanian refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, the United States and Germany.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Albania, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005 and 2009 to 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 2073 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 3036, at the end of 2005; it fell to a low in 2013 and then rose.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
